title: Restating a Settled Ridgecrest Advantage Claim Line on the Member’s Claim History
content:
Where the plan restates a medical claim line it has already settled under a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan, a corrected line is put in place of the settled line on the member's claim history and the money the member owes on it is recorded there.

A corrected liability is not fixed on a claim line before the enrollment it was rendered under stands in force with no coverage end date recorded on it. While a coverage end date still stands recorded on that enrollment, no corrected liability is fixed on the line.

The corrected line copies the date of service, the benefit category, the provider's contract standing on that date, the amount the plan recognises for the service, the provider and the line number from the line it replaces, records the money the member owes on it, marks the line as paid with no denial reason, and carries both the reference of the line it replaces and the reference of the coverage request that authorised the service. Afterwards the member's claim history shows the corrected line beside the line it replaces, and the money owed on the corrected line is what the member will be billed.

### How the corrected line is posted

The representative does this on the plan's behalf. The tool `post_corrected_claim_line_a6b381de` is first unlocked and then called.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `advantage_enrollment_id` | The reference number of the Medicare Advantage enrollment the service was given under, read from the member's enrollment record before the call | An identifier |
| `customer_id` | The member reference number, read from the member profile before the call | An identifier |
| `advantage_claim_id` | The reference number of the settled claim line being restated, read from the member's claim history before the call | An identifier |
| `advantage_service_request_id` | The reference number of the coverage request that authorised the service, read from the member's coverage requests before the call | An identifier |
| `member_cost_share` | The money the member owes on the corrected line, in USD | A decimal number carried to 2 decimal places, rounded half away from zero to the nearest cent at the moment it is passed; zero is written as 0.0, and an empty value is not accepted |

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the reference number the plan has assigned to the corrected line, a string beginning `acc`, the date of service it carries as YYYY-MM-DD, the money the member owes written to two decimal places in USD, and the reference number of the line it replaces. The sentence is returned only once the corrected line stands on the claim history, so its presence is what indicates the call completed.
